plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Adtran router. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory utilization, and interface traffic (enterprise PEN 664).
name: Router

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports Adtran AOS CPU utilization from ADTRAN-AOSCPU adGenAOSCurrentCpuUtil (Gauge32 0..100, OID 1.3.6.1.4.1.664.5.53.1.4.1.0), collected as a top-level SNMP scalar GET with instance .0.

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage_1min
metrics.description: This metric reports Adtran AOS one-minute average CPU utilization from ADTRAN-AOSCPU adGenAOS1MinCpuUtil (Gauge32 0..100, OID 1.3.6.1.4.1.664.5.53.1.4.3.0), collected as a top-level SNMP scalar GET with instance .0.

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage_5min
metrics.description: This metric reports Adtran AOS five-minute average CPU utilization from ADTRAN-AOSCPU adGenAOS5MinCpuUtil (Gauge32 0..100, OID 1.3.6.1.4.1.664.5.53.1.4.4.0), collected as a top-level SNMP scalar GET with instance .0.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: device_memory_total
metrics.description: This metric reports Adtran AOS total memory pool in bytes from ADTRAN-AOSCPU adGenAOSMemPool (OID 1.3.6.1.4.1.664.5.53.1.4.6.0), collected as a top-level SNMP scalar GET with instance .0.

metrics.name: device_memory_free
metrics.description: This metric reports Adtran AOS current heap free in bytes from ADTRAN-AOSCPU adGenAOSHeapFree (OID 1.3.6.1.4.1.664.5.53.1.4.8.0), collected as a top-level SNMP scalar GET with instance .0. This is not adGenAOSHeapSize (.4.7).

metrics.name: device_memory_used
metrics.description: This metric reports Adtran AOS used memory in bytes, derived as adGenAOSMemPool minus adGenAOSHeapFree.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports Adtran AOS memory utilization, derived as (adGenAOSMemPool - adGenAOSHeapFree) / adGenAOSMemPool * 100.

metrics.name: device_memory_heap_size
metrics.description: This metric reports Adtran AOS heap size in bytes from ADTRAN-AOSCPU adGenAOSHeapSize (OID 1.3.6.1.4.1.664.5.53.1.4.7.0), collected as a top-level SNMP scalar GET with instance .0. This is total heap after decompress, not free memory.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
